caption: Hold Alt+K to see the shortcuts
preconditions: Seeded newsroom (SEED.md) so the monitoring view behind the dimmed backdrop looks real; the overlay content itself does not depend on data
steps: Open #/workspace/monitoring and wait for [data-test-id="workspace-navigation"] to be visible

steps.script: document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'k', code: 'KeyK', altKey: true, bubbles: true}))

notes: The overlay is the sdKeyboardModal directive (scripts/core/keyboard/keyboard.ts, template scripts/core/keyboard/views/keyboard-modal.html, heading 'Keyboard Shortcuts'). It opens on keydown Alt+K and closes on keyup Alt+K, so a real key press closes it again before the shot: dispatch only the keydown event, as in the evaluate step. The listener is on document and checks event.key === 'k' with altKey only. Escape closes it (sd-modal). The list is long (groups General, Monitoring / List actions, Authoring, Search, Users); use the 1440x1100 viewport so the whole dialog fits, or crop the top part (General and Monitoring groups) if it still scrolls. At 1440x1700 the whole window, including the Monitoring / List actions group at the bottom, fits without scrolling. The spell checker row reads Option+S because the capture browser runs on macOS; on Windows and Linux it reads Alt+S.

caption: The spell checker button in the status bar
preconditions: Seeded newsroom (SEED.md): 'Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families' on desk Politics, unpublished and not locked by another user

Done by seed.py: A spell checker dictionary is available for the item's language (English). Without one, isSpellcheckerAvailable() is false and the button is not rendered. The e2e stack normally has the default English dictionary; check before running
Client config has no spellchecking.shortcut override, so the button title reads 'Spell checker on (Alt+S)' on Linux/Windows
steps: Open 'Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families' for editing from desk 'Politics'
notes: The button is in scripts/apps/authoring/views/authoring.html next to the 'Toggle theme' (proofread) button. Its state shows with the 'active' class. The hover text is a native title attribute ('Spell checker on (Alt+S)') and will not appear in a screenshot; the outline highlight is what points it out. Keep the crop landscape: the toggle is a small icon button, so include the status bar row around it (the Preview and Toggle theme buttons next to it).
